rationale: Single ENER draft-regulation detail page — a worked example proving the pattern, not a standalone feed; monitor the ENER parent instead.
Watchdog publishes recurring ENER consultation-compliance reports — a second index catching drafts pushed through shortened procedure.
Parliament's legislative-procedure tracker converts bills into dated reading/entry-into-force forecasts; core A3 deadline chain.
Official Gazette is the legal system of record that starts every vacatio legis clock; failed verification is soft, re-check liveness.
Banking association news stream is the best public proxy for NBRM consultation with industry, which has no open comment portal.
Finance ministry legislation page is the upstream proposer of banking/payments/FX primary law and hosts off-ENER public hearings.
NPAA gives per-chapter dated adoption targets for Ch.4/Ch.9 acts — the most explicit forward regulatory calendar available.
English mirror section of nbrm.mk (57 siblings); lags the Macedonian tree and carries no unique draft content.
Governance/composition sub-page of nbrm.mk; useful for actor mapping but the Council announcements feed is the monitorable parent.
Freely crawlable business-news mirror of NBRM Council releases — vital redundancy while nbrm.mk is bot-defended.
State service catalogue maps NBRM procedures to their legal bases; mine once for the bylaw-to-obligation map, then archive.
Lowest-latency NBRM broadcast mirror, but X/Twitter access and ToS are unclear — confirm collectability before approving.
High-value English legal-alert aggregator with explicit application dates, but Lexology requires registration/login.
Law-firm newsroom with recurring English notes on MK payment-services law and PSD2 harmonisation; public and in-scope.
Regional firm newsroom publishing fast English explainers with revised application dates for MK financial-market laws.
CMS MK country/practice page feeds law-now alerts and expert guides on banking and payments regimes in English.
Regional legal trade press with recurring MK banking & finance overviews and SEPA-accession commentary; re-check URL liveness.
Single comparative fintech guide — a useful baseline reference artifact, and Mondaq gates much content behind registration.
IMF country page yields dated Article IV/FSSA assessments of banking supervision with reform benchmark deadlines.
Global FSSA publication index; low MK-specific cadence — mine for scheduled/published MK FSAP, then rely on the country page.
World Bank MK hub and document repository carry payment-system modernisation work with NBRM and archive vanishing PDFs.
One RFx notice; the reveal-indirectly value is real but the monitorable object is the WB procurement search, not this page.
EBRD country page publishes strategies and legal-transition diagnostics setting financial-sector reform priorities.
EC enlargement country hub gives the annual, archived English scorecard on MK financial-services alignment.
MONEYVAL evaluations drive dated AML/CFT supervisory obligations for MK banks and payment service providers.
